exercises.title: 九年级 U13 听力·对话 Saving the Earth
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: The river near my home is so polluted now.
M: I know. It used to be clean and clear.
W: We should do something to help.
M: Yes. We can stop throwing litter into it.
W: And we should tell others to do the same.
exercises.translation_cn:
女:我家附近的河现在污染得很严重。
男:我知道。它以前又干净又清澈。
女:我们应该做点什么来帮忙。
男:是的。我们可以不再往里面扔垃圾。
女:我们还应该告诉别人也这样做。

questions.stem: What is the problem with the river?
What did the river used to be?
What does the woman say they should do?
What can they stop doing?
What else should they do?
options: Tell others to do the same.
questions.answer_text: Tell others to do the same.

exercises.title: 九年级 U13 听力·短文 Save the Sharks
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: Sharks are in danger today.
Every year, millions of sharks are killed for their fins.
Without their fins, the sharks cannot swim and soon die.
Sharks are at the top of the food chain.
We should all help save the sharks.
exercises.translation_cn:
如今鲨鱼正处于危险之中。
每年都有数百万条鲨鱼因鱼鳍而被杀。
没有了鳍,鲨鱼无法游泳,很快就会死去。
鲨鱼处于食物链的顶端。
我们都应该帮助拯救鲨鱼。

questions.stem: Are sharks in danger?

options: They cannot swim and soon die.
questions.answer_text: They cannot swim and soon die.

questions.stem: Where are sharks in the food chain?

exercises.title: 九年级 U13 听力·对话 The Three R's
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: Our school is starting a recycling program.
M: That's great! What can we do?
W: We can rethink, reuse, and recycle.
M: I always reuse old bottles and boxes.
W: And we can recycle paper, glass, and metal.
exercises.translation_cn:
女:我们学校要开展一个回收项目。
男:太好了!我们能做什么?
女:我们可以重新思考、再利用、回收。
男:我总是把旧瓶子和旧盒子再利用。
女:我们还可以回收纸、玻璃和金属。

questions.stem: What is the school starting?

exercises.title: 九年级 U13 听力·短文 The Bottle House
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: Mr. Lee loved to reuse old things.
He decided to build a house using old glass bottles.
People thought he was crazy at first.
After two years, the beautiful house was finished.
He showed that old things can become a work of art.
exercises.translation_cn:
李先生喜欢再利用旧物。
他决定用旧玻璃瓶建一座房子。
起初人们以为他疯了。
两年后,这座漂亮的房子建成了。
他证明了旧物也能成为艺术品。

questions.stem: What did Mr. Lee love to do?

options: A house using old glass bottles.
questions.answer_text: A house using old glass bottles.

exercises.title: 九年级 U13 听力·对话 A Reusable Bag
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: Do you want a plastic bag for your shopping?
M: No, thanks. I brought my own reusable bag.
W: That's a good idea. Plastic bags are bad for the earth.
M: Yes. A reusable bag can be used many times.
W: I should start using one too.
exercises.translation_cn:
女:你购物需要塑料袋吗?
男:不用,谢谢。我自己带了可重复使用的袋子。
女:这是个好主意。塑料袋对地球有害。
男:是的。可重复使用的袋子可以用很多次。
女:我也应该开始用一个了。

options: They are bad for the earth.
questions.answer_text: They are bad for the earth.

exercises.title: 九年级 U13 听力·短文 Green School Week
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: This week is Green School Week.
On Monday, turn off lights to save energy.
On Tuesday, bring a reusable water bottle.
On Thursday, put rubbish in the right bins to recycle.
Remember, every small action counts.
exercises.translation_cn:
这周是绿色校园周。
周一,关灯以节约能源。
周二,带一个可重复使用的水瓶。
周四,把垃圾放进正确的垃圾箱以便回收。
记住,每一个小行动都很重要。
